caption:
Girls' life is not easy… 💔
Har jagah, har waqt unhe judge kiya jata hai.

Agar chup rahe toh attitude, agar apni baat rakhe toh zyada bolti hai. Agar career choose kare toh ghar ki parwah nahi, aur agar ghar choose kare toh ambitious nahi. 🥺
Lekin ek ladki bhi insaan hai… uski bhi apni marzi, apne sapne aur apni choices hain. ✨

Bas ek din aisa ho… jab girls ko judge nahi, understand kiya jaye. ❤️‍🩹✨
